title: Facility Fee Allowance on the Arrival Credit of a Hotel Stay
content:
A facility allowance is added to the arrival credit on a reservation in the Hotel Rate Plans range according to the nights of the property facility fee already standing on the folio. Where the folio carries 6 nights or more of property facility fee, the facility allowance is 30.00 USD. Where it carries 3 nights or more but fewer than 6, the facility allowance is 15.00 USD. Where it carries fewer than 3 nights, the facility allowance is nil.

Only the property facility fee is counted here, and occupancy tax, city tax and parking are not. The count is a count of nights of that fee standing on the folio, not a money total.

**Read as input, judgement and result, on hypothetical folios.**

> Input: 6 nights of property facility fee on the folio.
> Judgement: 6 is not fewer than 6, so the top band is met.
> Result: 30.00 USD.

> Input: 5 nights of property facility fee on the folio.
> Judgement: fewer than 6 but not fewer than 3.
> Result: 15.00 USD.

> Input: 3 nights of property facility fee on the folio.
> Judgement: 3 is the foot of the middle band.
> Result: 15.00 USD.

> Input: 2 nights of property facility fee on the folio.
> Judgement: fewer than 3.
> Result: Nil.

> Input: 2 nights of property facility fee, 6 nights of parking and several statutory lines on the folio.
> Judgement: neither parking nor occupancy tax nor city tax is counted, so the property facility fee stands at 2 nights, which is fewer than 3.
> Result: Nil.
